name: Citation Select
description: Allows users to generate a citation based on a node.
project_description:
Adds a block that allows users to select and view citations of a node object from a list of citation styles.

 Back to top 

 Setup and Usage 
 Requirements 
 
 Token module 
 Bibcite module 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Block 
 
 Place block into Content under Structure › Block Layout 
 Select the content types that the block should appear in under Configure Block 
 
 Mapping 
 
 Navigate to CSL Format Mapping in Configuration 
 Select node fields to map citation fields from 
 
 Styles 
 
 Upload CSL styles using bibcite to add more citation options 
 
 Usage 
 
 Create a node as content type specified in the block 
 Add any required fields to node that correspond to what was set in CSL Format Mapping. Fields can be empty or non-existent. 
 Navigate to node page and choose citation format to view
